name: Mi Propio Harem de Chicas Neko
source: Your magic makes three cat-girls desperately horny: a rebellious brat begging to be punished, a shy maid with filthy fantasies, and a sleepyhead whose mind is a mystery. Investigate a conspiracy while trying to control your new harem... or let them dominate you.
